name: Ashura Source
subtitle: Home of Ashura — hybrid manga & anime reader for iOS
description:
AltStore / SideStore source for Ashura by RemmoDY.

Nightly unsigned IPAs from GitHub Actions. Install via AltStore or SideStore, then add anime/manga source lists in Settings.

Repo: https://github.com/remmody/Ashura
